top_signals.title: Japan’s Katayama Renews FX Warnings After US CPI Heats Up
top_signals.summary: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama warned speculators that she was prepared to take action in the currency market again if needed, after the yen touched its weakest level against the dollar this month following hotter US inflation figures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: India May Need Rate Hikes, Tax Cuts to Buoy Rupee, Analysts Say
top_signals.summary: India’s central bank has mounted its strongest defense of the rupee in more than a decade, and said it’s not done yet.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Kraken parent Payward to become first crypto firm to buy a EU bank as it expands into deposits, lending
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Quantitative tightening: the next chapter − speech by Dave Ramsden
top_signals.summary: Given at the Bank of England, co-hosted by the Money, Macro and Finance Society
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Russian travel booking platform suspends reservations after cyberattack
top_signals.summary: Customers of Russian travel website Anywayanyday were unable to book tickets or hotel rooms as the company responded to a cyberattack.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: EU authority classifies Circle’s USDC as ‘significant’ under MiCA
top_signals.summary: The second-largest stablecoin by market cap will be overseen by French and EU authorities under its classification as a “significant e-money token.“
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
